Paradigm researcher Dan Robi
content:
Paradigm Proposes PACTs for Quantum-Resilient Bitcoin Ownership Proofs

Paradigm researcher Dan Robinson proposed a scheme called PACTs (Provable Address-Control Timestamps), which allows Bitcoin holders to generate proof of control over an address via blockchain timestamps without moving assets or triggering on-chain activity. This enables ownership to be recorded before quantum computing can break private keys, and later used to claim assets in a quantum-secure version of the Bitcoin network.
